feed.caption:
Tidy-up time, but make it a race ⏳

Let your little one set KidPad's visual timer themselves, then try to beat it before every toy is back in the box. Next round, swap who sets the timer.

It helps them see time passing instead of hearing "five more minutes" on repeat.

KidPad, £2.99 once. Link in bio.
